patterns: What kind of platform is this?
responses: Mallify is a virtual mall where anyone can access and open a shop to sell products. We provide a platform for both shoppers to find various products and vendors to set up their online shops easily.

patterns: How do I create a shop?
I want to sell on Mallify
responses: To create a shop on Mallify, go to the 'Become a Seller' section and fill out the registration form. You'll need to provide your shop details, contact information, and upload some product images. Our team will review your application and approve it shortly.

You can manage your shop through the Seller Dashboard. Log in to your account, go to 'My Shop', and you'll find options to add/edit products, update shop information, view orders, and track your performance.

Shopping on Mallify is easy! Browse products, add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, fill in your delivery details, and choose payment on delivery. You'll receive confirmation and can track your order status from your account.

At Mallify, we currently offer payment on delivery to ensure a safer shopping experience. When your order arrives, you can pay in cash directly to the delivery person. We're working on adding more payment options in the future.

patterns: When will I receive my order?
responses: Delivery times depend on your location and the seller. Typically, orders are delivered within 2-5 business days. You can track your order status from your account dashboard under 'My Orders'.

If you're not satisfied with your purchase, you can initiate a return within 7 days of delivery. Contact the seller directly through the platform, explain the issue, and follow the return instructions. Refunds are processed once the returned item is received.

For account issues, click 'Forgot Password' on the login page to reset your password. To update account information, log in and go to 'My Account' settings. If you're still having trouble, contact our support team for assistance.
You can find products by using the search bar at the top of the page, browsing categories, or using filters for price, brand, etc. You can also explore featured shops and products on our homepage.

I'm sorry you're experiencing technical issues. Try refreshing the page or clearing your browser cache. If the problem persists, please contact our technical support at support@mallify.com with details about the issue.

You can contact our support team through the 'Contact Us' page, by email at support@mallify.com, or use the live chat feature at the bottom right of the screen during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM, Monday to Friday).

We're excited to announce that a Mallify mobile app is coming soon! We're currently developing applications for both iOS and Android to make your shopping experience even more convenient. Stay tuned for the launch announcement.

patterns: How much does it cost to sell?
responses: Mallify charges a competitive commission of 5% on each sale. There are no monthly fees or listing charges - you only pay when you make a sale. This includes access to all seller tools and features on our platform.

Mallify supports a wide range of categories including fashion, electronics, home & garden, beauty, sports, toys, and more. Prohibited items include illegal goods, weapons, adult content, and counterfeit products. Check our seller guidelines for a complete list.

To create an account, click the 'Sign Up' button in the top right corner of the page. Fill in your details (name, email, password), agree to the terms, and click 'Create Account'. You'll receive a confirmation email to verify your account.
Mallify supports multiple languages including English, Arabic, French, and German. You can change your preferred language from the dropdown menu in the top navigation bar.

patterns: How to save products for later
responses: You can save products to your wishlist by clicking the heart icon on any product. To view your saved items, log in to your account and go to 'My Wishlist'. From there, you can move items to your cart or remove them from your wishlist.

You can track your order by logging into your account and going to 'My Orders'. Click on the specific order to see its current status and tracking information. If the seller has provided a tracking number, you'll be able to click on it to see detailed delivery updates.

At Mallify, we take your security and privacy seriously. We use industry-standard encryption for all transactions, never store complete credit card information, and have strict data protection policies in place. You can review our detailed Privacy Policy in the footer of our website.

You can see shop ratings on each seller's profile page. After completing a purchase, you'll receive an invitation to rate and review the seller. These ratings help other shoppers make informed decisions and help us maintain quality standards across Mallify.

After receiving your order, you can write a product review by going to 'My Orders', finding the item, and clicking 'Write a Review'. Your honest feedback helps other customers and also helps sellers improve their products and services.

Many sellers on Mallify offer gift options! During checkout, look for the 'Send as Gift' option. Depending on the seller, you may be able to add gift wrapping, a personalized message, or a gift receipt. The available gift options will be displayed on the product page or during checkout.

International shipping availability depends on the individual sellers on Mallify. When browsing products, you can filter for items that ship to your country. During checkout, you'll see shipping options and costs for international delivery if the seller offers it.

Yes, Mallify is active on social media! You can follow us on Instagram (@mallify_official), Facebook (Mallify Marketplace), Twitter (@mallify), and LinkedIn. We regularly post about new shops, product highlights, and special promotions.

Each seller provides their own size guide on the product page. Look for the 'Size Guide' link near the size selection. If you're unsure, you can also message the seller directly for personalized sizing advice.
Size charts are available on individual product pages. Click 'Size Guide' to see measurements. Remember that sizes may vary between different sellers and brands on Mallify.

For bulk orders, contact the seller directly through their shop page. Many sellers offer quantity discounts for large orders. You can also reach out to our business support team at business@mallify.com for assistance with wholesale purchases.

Many sellers on Mallify offer customization services! Look for the 'Customization Available' badge on product pages, or contact sellers directly to discuss your specific requirements. Custom orders may take longer to process and ship.

Some sellers offer pre-orders for upcoming products. These will be clearly marked as 'Pre-Order' with expected availability dates. You'll be charged when the item ships, and you can cancel pre-orders anytime before shipping.

Mallify's loyalty program rewards frequent shoppers with points for every purchase! Earn 1 point per dollar spent, get exclusive access to sales, and redeem points for discounts. Join by going to 'My Account' > 'Loyalty Program'.

While Mallify doesn't have a formal price matching policy since our sellers set their own prices, you can contact individual sellers to discuss pricing. Many sellers are willing to negotiate, especially for multiple items or return customers.

Some sellers offer subscription services for regularly needed items like beauty products, pet supplies, or household goods. Look for the 'Subscribe & Save' option on eligible products to set up automatic deliveries with discounts.

Some fashion and beauty sellers on Mallify offer virtual try-on features using AR technology. Look for the 'Virtual Try-On' button on supported products to see how items look on you before purchasing.

Mallify promotes sustainable shopping! Use our 'Eco-Friendly' filter to find products from environmentally conscious sellers. Look for badges like 'Sustainable Materials', 'Carbon Neutral Shipping', and 'Eco-Certified' on product pages.
Support local businesses on Mallify! Use the location filter to find sellers in your area. Local purchases often mean faster delivery, lower shipping costs, and supporting your community's economy.

Mallify verifies sellers through our trust program. Look for verification badges like 'Verified Seller', 'Top Rated', and 'Mallify Certified' on shop pages. These indicate sellers who have met our quality and reliability standards.

Don't miss our flash sales! Check the homepage daily for lightning deals that last only a few hours. You can also enable push notifications in your account settings to get alerts about flash sales in your favorite categories.

Set up product alerts to never miss a deal! On any product page, click 'Set Alert' to get notified about price drops, restocks, or sales. You can manage all your alerts from 'My Account' > 'Product Alerts'.

Join group buying events for better prices! Some sellers offer group discounts when multiple customers purchase together. Look for 'Group Buy' events on the homepage or in the 'Special Offers' section.

Experience live shopping on Mallify! Some sellers host live streams to showcase products, answer questions in real-time, and offer exclusive live-only deals. Check the 'Live Now' section on our homepage.

Some products on Mallify require age verification for legal compliance. You'll be prompted to verify your age during checkout for restricted items. We use secure age verification services to protect your privacy.

Protect your purchases with Mallify's optional product insurance! Available for electronics and high-value items, it covers accidental damage, theft, and extends warranty coverage. Add insurance during checkout for eligible products.

Need personalized shopping help? Our virtual shopping assistants can help you find the perfect products based on your preferences, budget, and needs. Start a consultation by clicking 'Personal Shopping' in your account menu.

Mallify doesn't charge buyers any additional fees! The price you see is what you pay, plus shipping costs set by the seller. We only charge sellers a small commission to maintain and improve the platform.

If you have an issue with an order, first try contacting the seller directly. If that doesn't resolve the problem, open a dispute in our Resolution Center within 30 days of delivery. Our mediation team will help find a fair solution.

You can cancel your order from 'My Orders' if it hasn't been shipped yet. Click on the order and select 'Cancel Order'. If it's already shipped, you'll need to return it after delivery.
To cancel an order, go to your account dashboard and find the order in 'My Orders'. Orders can only be cancelled before they're shipped.
Order modifications are possible only before shipping. Go to 'My Orders', select your order, and click 'Modify' if available. For shipped orders, please contact the seller directly.
You can modify unshipped orders from your account dashboard. Changes to address, quantity, or items may be possible depending on the seller's policy.
Check your refund status in 'My Orders' > 'Returns & Refunds'. Refunds typically take 3-7 business days to process after the seller receives the returned item.
Refund processing times vary by payment method: 3-5 days for cards, 1-2 days for digital wallets. You'll receive email updates on the refund progress.
To exchange an item, initiate a return from 'My Orders' and select 'Exchange' as the reason. Choose your preferred replacement and we'll process both the return and new order together.
Exchanges are available within the seller's return window. The new item will be sent once we receive your return, or you can pay the difference if there's a price change.
Sorry to hear about the damaged item! Please report it immediately through 'My Orders' > 'Report Issue'. Take photos of the damage and packaging - this helps us process your claim faster.
For damaged items, contact the seller within 48 hours of delivery. Most sellers will offer immediate replacement or full refund for damaged products.
If your item hasn't arrived within the expected timeframe, first check with neighbors or building management. Then report it through 'My Orders' > 'Item Not Received' for investigation.
For missing packages, we'll track with the shipping carrier and contact the seller. You're protected by our buyer guarantee - you'll get a refund or replacement.
If you received the wrong item, report it through 'My Orders' > 'Wrong Item Received'. We'll arrange for the correct item to be sent and provide a return label for the incorrect one.
Wrong item deliveries are covered by our guarantee. Contact the seller immediately, and they'll send the correct product while arranging pickup of the wrong item.
For delivery issues, first check the tracking information in 'My Orders'. If there are problems, contact our delivery support team who can coordinate with the shipping carrier.
Delivery problems can usually be resolved by contacting the carrier directly. If unsuccessful, our customer service team can escalate the issue and find alternative solutions.
Payment failures can occur due to insufficient funds, expired cards, or bank security measures. Try a different payment method or contact your bank to authorize the transaction.
If your payment failed, check your card details and try again. You can also use alternative payment methods available at checkout.
Pending payments usually resolve within 24 hours. This can happen with bank transfers or when additional verification is required. Your order will be processed once payment is confirmed.
Some payment methods take longer to process. Check your payment status in 'My Orders' or contact your bank if the payment remains pending for more than 2 business days.
Download your invoice from 'My Orders' by clicking on the specific order and selecting 'Download Invoice'. For business invoices with specific details, contact the seller directly.
Invoices are automatically generated for all orders. Access them through your account dashboard under 'My Orders' > 'Invoice/Receipt'.
Download your receipt from 'My Orders' section. Click on any order to view details and download the receipt as PDF. Receipts are available immediately after purchase.
All purchase receipts are stored in your account. Go to 'My Orders', select the order, and click 'Download Receipt' for a PDF copy.
Detailed product specifications are available on each product page under the 'Specifications' tab. This includes dimensions, materials, technical features, and compatibility information.
Find complete product specs by scrolling down on the product page. If you need additional technical information, you can contact the seller directly through their shop page.
Warranty information is provided by individual sellers and varies by product. Check the product page for warranty details, or contact the seller for specific warranty terms and claim procedures.
Most products come with manufacturer warranty. Warranty terms, duration, and claim process are detailed on the product page under 'Warranty Information'.
Care instructions are usually included with your product or available on the product page. For specific care guidance, check the 'Care & Maintenance' section or contact the seller.
Proper care instructions help extend product life. Look for care labels on the product or download care guides from the product page under 'Additional Information'.
Find similar products in the 'You May Also Like' section on any product page, or use our 'Find Similar' feature to discover comparable items from different sellers.
Our recommendation engine suggests similar products based on your browsing history and other customers' purchases. Check the 'Related Products' section for alternatives.
Many sellers offer bundle deals for related products. Look for 'Bundle & Save' options on product pages, or check the 'Special Offers' section for current bundle promotions.
Bundle deals provide great value when buying multiple related items. These are highlighted on product pages and in our 'Deals' section with clear savings information.
Check out our 'New Arrivals' section updated daily with the latest products from all sellers. You can also filter by category to see new items in your areas of interest.
Stay updated with new products by following your favorite sellers or enabling notifications for specific categories in your account preferences.
Discover our bestsellers in the 'Popular Products' section, updated weekly based on sales data and customer ratings. These represent the most loved items on Mallify.
Bestsellers are great starting points for shopping. Find them on our homepage or use the 'Sort by Popularity' filter in any category.
Browse seasonal collections updated throughout the year for holidays, weather changes, and special occasions. Find them in our 'Seasonal' section or homepage banners.
Seasonal products are curated for timely relevance. Check back regularly as we update collections for holidays, back-to-school, summer, winter, and special events.
Manage your cart by clicking the cart icon. You can update quantities, remove items, save for later, or apply discount codes. Your cart is saved across devices when logged in.
Cart management features include quantity updates, item removal, and saving items for later. You can also see shipping estimates and apply promotional codes before checkout.
Save items for later by clicking the 'Save for Later' button in your cart or the heart icon on product pages. Access saved items from your account dashboard.
Your saved items are stored in your wishlist and remain there until you move them to cart or remove them. You'll also get notifications about price drops on saved items.
Yes, you can checkout as a guest without creating an account. Simply select 'Continue as Guest' during checkout. However, creating an account helps track orders and saves your preferences.
Guest checkout is available for quick purchases. You'll need to provide shipping and payment information, but won't have access to order history or tracking without an account.
Use express checkout with saved payment methods and addresses for faster purchases. Enable 'Quick Buy' in your account settings to streamline future checkouts.
Express checkout uses your default shipping address and payment method. You can modify these before confirming, or set up multiple quick-checkout profiles.
Some sellers offer installment payment options for higher-value items. Look for 'Pay in Installments' during checkout, or check if the seller supports payment plan services.
Installment payments are available through third-party services for eligible purchases. Terms and interest rates vary by provider and are shown during checkout.
Prices are automatically converted to your local currency based on your location. You can change currency from the dropdown in the top navigation bar.
Currency conversion uses real-time exchange rates. Final charges may vary slightly due to your bank's conversion rates and any international transaction fees.
Tax calculation depends on your location and the seller's location. Taxes are calculated at checkout and clearly displayed before you complete your purchase.
Some prices include tax while others add it at checkout. Tax information is shown on product pages and detailed in your order summary before payment.
Shipping costs are calculated based on your location, item weight, and selected delivery speed. Enter your postal code on the product page to see shipping options and costs.
Use our shipping calculator at checkout to compare delivery options and costs. Some sellers offer free shipping above certain order values.
Some sellers offer pickup locations to save on shipping costs. Available pickup points are shown during checkout if the seller supports this option.
Pickup locations include partner stores, lockers, and seller locations. You'll receive notification when your order is ready for collection, usually within 1-2 business days.
Same-day delivery is available in select cities for eligible products ordered before the cutoff time (usually 2 PM). Check product pages for same-day delivery availability.
Express delivery options vary by seller and location. Same-day delivery typically costs more but ensures you receive your order within hours of purchase.
